comments.text: Looks correct: email keeps priority (stable sort moves it first, on a clone so the collection config isn't mutated), the email field is skipped only for non-email values, and every other identity field is now tried as a fallback, so email-formatted usernames authenticate even when the email lookup misses or `email` isn't configured. Nits: use core.FieldNameEmail instead of the "email" literal in the comparator (it also returns -1 for a==b=="email", harmless since fields are unique), and make sure the now-unused `list` import is removed and `slices` is imported. The regression test covers the reported case.
